findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document reads
findings.body: The function now returns true even when userTenant and documentTenant differ, so any consumer relying on this authorization check will permit cross-tenant document reads. This directly defeats the tenant boundary enforced by the previous equality comparison and can expose one tenant's documents to another.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally; the full PR diff shows this replaced `userTenant === documentTenant`, so differing tenant IDs are accepted. Repository search finds no alternate enforcement around this exported predicate, and the participant's trusted-administrator claim is not established by source.
